summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of misleading error messages when accessing non-existent attributes in subclasses of SkyCoord. However, it introduces a potential behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of the __getattr__ method to check if the attribute exists in the class before raising an AttributeError. This could potentially break existing behavior where subclasses rely on the current behavior of raising an AttributeError for non-existent attributes.
